data.title: 椎名真昼 · 邻家厨房围裙微烫的早餐·「周总是起这么晚……再不吃煎蛋要凉了」
data.description: 【周的公寓厨房·晨光】穿着粉色荷叶边围裙的真昼正在料理台前忙碌。晨光透过窗台把她的金发染成明亮的琥珀色，她手里端着刚出锅的日式玉子烧与味噌汤，侧头看向揉着惺忪睡眼的周，眼神里满是妻子般的娇嗔。
data.location: 邻家客厅开放式厨房料理台前
data.action: 端着热气腾腾的玉子烧托盘回头，金发侧挽，娇嗔微翘嘴角
data.lighting: 朝阳晨光穿透玻璃窗洒在白净料理台与围裙上
data.camera: medium shot, apron, holding plate, breakfast, warm morning sun
data.mood: 日常被惯成废人、温柔投喂
data.promptProse: Mahiru Shiina turns from Amane's kitchen counter with tamagoyaki and miso soup ready, watching him rub sleep from his eyes. A pastel-pink ruffled apron covers her beige sweater and long dark skirt, golden hair loosely gathered to one side. The medium view includes the clean cooking surface and window behind. Morning sun illuminates apron ruffles and egg edges, returning pale reflected light from the counter onto her expectant face.
